release_notes:
Simplify: use placeimeiorder/getimeiorder directly for server orders, drop the retry

placeserverorder/getserverorder were never the real DHRU Fusion standard, only a
vendor extension. Two suppliers (ifoneunlock.com, PaidUnlock) have now dropped it
and needed the fallback retry to placeimeiorder/getimeiorder, which always worked.
No currently active supplier has succeeded via placeserverorder without that
fallback, so call the standard action directly instead of trying the extension
first and retrying on rejection.
